How this works

No shoot day. No photographer. Nothing lands on your staff.

  • Nobody gets booked.

    No studio, no set, no crew standing in your dining room through a lunch service.

  • We work from the photographs that already exist.

    Yours, and the ones your customers keep taking. A phone photo carries far more than people expect once the light and the setting are rebuilt around it.

  • Your food is never redrawn.

    The dish in the picture is the dish you serve, down to the char on the pork and the print on your bowls. What changes is the room around it.

  • You pick one of two rhythms.

    A large bank of content delivered up front, months of material at once. Or a monthly bank plus a calendar telling you which photo goes out on which day with which caption. Either way the deciding leaves your desk.

Both accounts together

Both restaurants, one price.

Same team, same schedule, same person to talk to, one invoice. Most of the work of starting an account happens once, so running the two together costs less than running them apart.
